title: Use Your iPhone as a Lit Mirror Without a Photo
description: Use the live front-camera view and adjustable screen light to check makeup on an iPhone. Keep the preview open without saving a photo.
direct: Open a live front-camera mirror with adjustable screen light. Set the light while you check your face, and leave the capture button untouched if you only need a preview.
figureAlt: A phone on a stand casts soft neutral screen light as a person uses it as a makeup mirror.
figureCaption: AI illustration of a hands-free mirror setup. No app controls are depicted.
cards.decision.heading: Use the screen for a quick check
cards.decision.body: A front camera helps you check a small area when a mirror or lamp is out of reach. Camera exposure and your screen can change the appearance, so use the view to check edges and placement.
sections.detail-1.heading: Keep your hands free
sections.detail-1.body: Rest the phone on a stand if you need both hands. Move the phone or turn your face for a better angle. If the light feels uncomfortable or you need to examine a precise shade, switch to a mirror in soft light.
sections.detail-2.heading: Preview and capture are separate
sections.detail-2.body: Space Sheep Studio develops GlowPop for iPhone. The current listing lets you adjust the screen light while the camera is open and preview every light color for free. If you later take a picture, new photos save to the app album and Photos by default. Pro covers unlimited photos and video recording.
sources.store.label: GlowPop: Selfie Glow Camera 1.0.6 on the App Store
related.related.label: Related practical guide
steps.step-1.text: Open GlowPop: Selfie Glow Camera and grant camera access. Put the phone at a comfortable distance where you can see the live front-camera view.
steps.step-2.text: Begin with a neutral screen color and increase brightness in small steps. Tilt the phone slightly if you see glare. Check the area you want without tapping capture.
steps.step-3.text: Check the result in ordinary room light or a physical mirror when color or texture matters. Close the preview when you are finished.
